message: Vector Rebel 3.2.92: BC Check fits both full months on one desktop screen.
releaseNotes: BC Check now uses the available desktop window width and a compact 10-tour layout across the entire previous/current month. Personnel and unit columns are kept visible, with short dated headings; full PPE statuses, inspection evidence, and read-only provenance remain available by hovering over each compact cell. No change to native inspection submissions, CrewSense edits, background collector or Captain item reports. 3.2.91 functional fixes are retained.
